text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was waiting at the venue with Rice 
Shower for an interview in racewear today.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Deep breath, deep breath. Inhale... 
exhale...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Just a little...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I got the questions in advance and 
practiced my answers, so I'll be fine...!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While we are talking, the interviewer 
comes running over to us in a panic.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
Um, Rice Shower-san! Excuse me, but could 
I have a moment—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes!?

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
About the questions I handed you earlier, 
it turns out those were meant for a 
different interview...

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
It seems there was a mix-up on our end and 
the wrong item was delivered...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh—

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
I am so terribly sorry! Even after all the 
preparations you made for me—

text_block_list.name: Cameraman A
text_block_list.text:
What do we do... We won't get any kind of 
interview like this...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The interviewers seem troubled as well. 
Just as I was thinking about what to do—"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: —U-Um!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Whatever you want to ask... please, ask 
away! Even if it's off-script, I don't 
mind at all!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: If it is something I can answer, I will—

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text: R-Really!? That would be a huge help, but—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister—

text_block_list.name: Cameraman A
text_block_list.text:
Since Trainer gave permission too, I'll 
gladly take you up on that. Thank you very 
much.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, that really helps...! Well 
then, Rice Shower, are you ready?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: —Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower answered with dignified poise, 
bringing the interview to a successful 
close—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Big Brother. How did Rice do with her 
answers?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "...Onee-sama. How were Rice's answers?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
During the interview, just like in a race, 
I felt like this outfit gave me 
courage...!
choice_data_list: So you had someone to support you, huh.

You had someone to support you, didn't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ...But that's not all.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The one who supported Rice the most... The 
one who gave Rice the most courage was—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ――It's Big Brother, you know.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ――It's Big Sister, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying that, Rice Shower gave a small, 
blissful smile.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Finally, just a tiny bit—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I've become someone worthy of this 
outfit.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe. Saying it myself is kind of 
embarrassing...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...It's all because you believed in Rice, 
Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...It's all thanks to you believing in 
me, Big Sis."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"So please... always keep believing in 
Rice."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I responded to her words with a firm 
nod, she gave me a blissful smile.
